Cloudflare Pages deployment requires these repository secrets:

- CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: a Cloudflare API token with Pages:Edit permission
- CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: your Cloudflare account ID
- CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_PROJECT_NAME: optional, the exact Cloudflare Pages project name (defaults to hytera-bd)

Set them in GitHub repository settings > Secrets and variables > Actions.
